source_documents.title: Hydrolytic stability and non-radiative decay processes of dibenzoylmethanatoboron difluoride derivatives

reference_evidence_units.quote: The observed linear correlation between the activation energy of isomerization and the logarithm of the nonradiative rate constant further supports this hypothesis
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBMBF2 series
reference_evidence_units.statement: ln knr correlates with the computed barrier to the bent isomer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the out-of-plane motion of the phenyl ring can lead to the formation of a bent isomer
reference_evidence_units.subject: DBMBF2 series
reference_evidence_units.statement: The quenching motion is phenyl out-of-plane bending towards a conical intersection.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Proposed in earlier work and adopted here.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Non-radiative decay through phenyl out-of-plane bending to a bent isomer near a conical intersection, with a substituent-tuned barrier. Boundary case (RIM vs RADIATIVE): quenching through an intramolecular motion whose barrier or coupling is tuned by substituents, not restricted by an environment; labelled RIM by guideline §3.2 (access to a conical intersection along a motion).

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Quantum-yield changes are analysed as changes of knr at nearly constant kr.
